issue.description:
## Problem (verified 2026-08-29)
- Latest GitHub release v0.2.1 (2026-08-26) has exactly one asset: `bead`. No `bead-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, no `checksums.txt`, no `install.sh`.
- README.md leads with `curl -fsSL https://github.com/jedarden/bead-rs/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash` -> HTTP 404.
- beadrs-778fbff1 (arch-suffixed binary + checksums) and beadrs-7be0535b (install.sh + README) are closed and their work IS in main (install.sh at 97b6e2c, 2026-08-28) — but main is 8 commits past v0.2.1 and Cargo.toml still says 0.2.1. Nothing was released.
- NEEDLE's installer bundling (needle-b85c2d42) is gated on needle-6de75655, which verifies exactly these assets on the LATEST release.
- NEEDLE's README also says bead-rs prebuilt installers are "coming soon"; GitHub NEEDLE#16 has been open since 2026-08-19 on this.

## Deliverable
1. Bump Cargo.toml (and Cargo.lock) to 0.2.2; CHANGELOG entry listing the install contract and the other 8 commits.
2. Tag v0.2.2 and let the normal bead-rs release WorkflowTemplate in declarative-config/k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/ publish it. If the template does not upload install.sh/checksums.txt/the arch-suffixed name yet, fix the template first (Forgejo push; ArgoCD app argo-workflows-ns-iad-ci syncs) — do not hand-upload assets.
3. Verify: `gh release view v0.2.2 --repo jedarden/bead-rs --json assets,isDraft` lists bead-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, checksums.txt, install.sh, isDraft=false; `sha256sum -c` passes; in a container with no Rust the README one-liner installs `bead` and `bead --version` prints 0.2.2.
4. Record the asset list and the sha256sum result in the close reason (needle-6de75655 will copy them).

## Definition of done
`curl -fsSL https://github.com/jedarden/bead-rs/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash` works on a clean Linux x86_64 host; the v0.2.2 release is not a draft (see project memory: Forgejo mirror tag pruning has demoted releases to draft before — check after the mirror sync too).
issue.title: Cut the bead-rs release that ships the install contract: v0.2.1 has only 'bead', so the README one-liner 404s and NEEDLE's installer cannot bundle it

issue.description:
ADR-002 commits to agent-guided rehydration producing a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, recording source repository and commit, and its drawbacks section names batching, resumable reports, and duplicate detection as requirements for large repositories — none of which has a bead or a defined artifact contract. Specify the reconciliation report format, decide which parts are documentation versus public CLI support (without reintroducing import adapters or any native-store write path), and add duplicate-detection guidance for bulk rehydration.

Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
